title: Global Endpoint Poisson Approximation
map_title: Global Endpoint Poisson Approximation extraction map
abstract: For uniformly endpoint-regularly varying Luce arrays, this paper proves total-variation approximation of the global fixed-point count by a Poisson law with its exact mean, with error of order (log log n)/sqrt(log n), and hence a centered normal limit. The proof combines an approximate-Palm Stein bound, an exact terminal-rank transposition and likelihood ratio, a quantitative endpoint saddle, and two-cycle transition control.
